note: Criteria text is a MEASURED VARIABLE, not fixed harness. Alexei's pi-model-router showed rewording moved Jev confidence 30%->90% on identical inputs. Vary this file, never the evidence, to measure wording sensitivity.

lane.question: Which part of Oleg's life does this belong to?

options.work: Canarian business: partners, investors, customers, prospects, vendors and billing for work tools, industry reading kept for work, recruiting.
options.personal: Outside the company: family, children's school or camp, personal shopping, hobbies, language learning, personal health or finance, friends.
options.both: Genuinely serves both, such as a tool paid personally but used for the company, or a friend who is also a business contact.
options.unclear: The evidence does not distinguish work from personal.

options.known-human: A real person Oleg has corresponded with before; a reply from him is plausible.
options.new-human: A real person writing for the first time: cold outreach, an introduction, an inbound enquiry.
options.automated-transactional: Machine-generated about Oleg's own account or money: receipt, invoice, calendar invite, auth code, delivery, account alert.
options.automated-bulk: Machine-generated broadcast to many: newsletter, digest, marketing, product announcement, social notification.
options.unclear: The sender's nature cannot be determined.

action.question: What does this need from Oleg?

options.reply: A person is waiting for a written answer from Oleg.
options.schedule: A meeting to accept, decline, move or propose.
options.pay-or-sign: Money or signature: invoice, renewal, failed payment, contract, legal document.
options.security: Account security: login alert, verification code, password reset, breach notice, suspicious activity.
options.read-later: Worth Oleg's attention but needs no action and has no deadline.
options.archive: No action now or later; safe to file away unread.

options.ai-agents: LLMs, agents, model releases, agent tooling and evaluation.
options.devops-cloud: Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, observability, CI/CD, platform engineering.
options.business-gtm: Fundraising, go-to-market, hiring, product strategy, startup operations.
options.finance-admin: Invoices, receipts, subscriptions, taxes, corporate admin.
options.personal-life: Family, children, health, hobbies, personal purchases and travel.
